name: Partial / Half Covered Call
summary: Write calls against only a fraction of the share position (e.g. 3 calls against 500 shares) so upside participation is retained on the unwritten shares.

legs.strike_rule: 0.25-0.30 delta; contracts = floor(shares/100) x coverage_ratio, coverage_ratio in [0.3, 0.7]

max_profit: unlimited on the uncovered shares plus capped gain and credits on the covered portion
breakevens: blended share basis - (total credits / total shares)
when_to_use: Underlying is in a confirmed uptrend but IV is rich enough to want some income. Use when a full overwrite would too aggressively cap a trending position.
entry_rules: contracts_sold = floor(shares_held / 100 x coverage_ratio); coverage_ratio configurable, default 0.5, hard cap 1.0 (never more contracts than share lots - that would be a ratio write and level 4).
All standard covered call gates apply to the contracts actually sold.
Increase coverage_ratio toward 1.0 when the 20-day realized vol percentile > 70 or the trend filter flips neutral; reduce toward 0.3 when the 50/200 SMA trend is strongly up.
management_rules: 50% profit target / 21 DTE roll, same as the standard covered call.
Re-evaluate coverage_ratio at each new cycle based on the trend filter.
Never let contracts_sold exceed floor(shares_held/100), including after a partial share sale - recheck cover before every share sale.
exit_rules: Same hard assignment guard: ITM short calls closed by 15:30 ET on expiration day.
If shares are sold for any reason, buy back a proportional number of calls FIRST so cover is never lost.
Extrinsic < 0.05 and delta > 0.85 triggers immediate close.
assignment_risk: Identical to the covered call on the written portion. The system-level risk is cover accounting: a share sale that drops share count below 100 x contracts converts covered calls into naked calls, which the account is not approved for.
buying_power: Shares only, provided cover accounting is correct.
common_mistakes: Selling shares without reducing contracts and creating an accidental naked short call; drifting coverage upward in a rally.
zero_dte_notes: Partial coverage is a sensible way to run 0DTE overwrites: write against half the lots so a surprise rally still participates.
family: Stock/ETF Shares Combined With Options (covered writes, protective hedges, collars, synthetics, repairs, conversions)
